title: CERT@VDE advisory VDE-2026-154: four vulnerabilities in CODESYS Visualization
date_note: The day CERT@VDE published the advisory; the page gives no earlier day.
geo_basis: country; CERT@VDE is a German CERT
summary: CERT@VDE advisory VDE-2026-154 lists CVE-2026-121016, CVE-2026-121017 and CVE-2026-121018 (each rated 8.8) and CVE-2026-121019 (rated 3.3) in CODESYS Visualization. Per the advisory, the first three need a user logged in to a CODESYS Control runtime and an attacker controlling a malicious runtime or intercepting the traffic. The advisory does not state whether they are exploited.
plain: Four flaws in CODESYS Visualization, used with industrial controllers, were published. The advisory says three could let a malicious runtime or an interceptor run functions on an engineering workstation.
exec: CERT@VDE lists four CODESYS Visualization flaws; the advisory does not say whether any is exploited.
action: CERT@VDE advises updating CODESYS Visualization to version 4.11.0.0, enabling encrypted online communication between the CODESYS Development System and Control runtime, and using only trusted CODESYS projects.

sources.name: Canadian Centre for Cyber Security: Codesys security advisory (AV26-1199)

validation.note: Primary: CERT@VDE's advisory VDE-2026-154, the Canadian Centre for Cyber Security's AV26-1199 notice lists no CVEs, so it is not counted as corroboration.

review.note: action: added the advisory's own remediation (update to 4.11.0.0); CVEs, scores, preconditions and date match CERT@VDE
